The primary product is clearly identified as the AFP white-and-blue cylindrical drip tape roll, featuring the authentic blue water-drop logo and 'AFP' typography consistent with the reference. The secondary Persian text is clearly visible and correctly associated with the product. The scene context aligns perfectly with the article's agronomy focus, featuring neutral seedlings and continuous flattened drip laterals with visible root-zone wetting. A small unspooled coil of black tape is present next to the carton, which acts as a cohesive visual bridge to the installed irrigation lines and is not considered a 'wrong product' or an unsupported hose-family item. The required watermark 'AFP | 09134922013' is present and legible in the bottom right. No core defects such as mixed product families, fake branding, or impossible geometry are observed. Minor framing details do not impact the overall editorial quality, which remains well above the 90-point threshold.
